I haven't run these; they are experiment designs only. They form 20 groups of 5. Within each group, the same edit is applied to parents that differ only in one other parent edge, which cycles through all five ops. Comparing edit effects within a group isolates how that parent edge conditions the edit. The groups cover edits to every edge, with ops including conv, skip, none, and pool.
